name: SFeraKon
blurb: The oldest Croatian science-fiction convention and one of Central Europe's largest, held each spring in Zagreb.

editions.evidence: Homepage social feed: '49. SFeraKon in the making, 7. - 9. 5. 2027. #sferakon #sfera #sferakon2027 Announcement coming soon!'

notes: The homepage still headlines 'SFeraKon 2026' (8-10 May 2026, the 48th edition, already ended before today), but its own embedded social-post feed already teases the 49th edition's dates, 7-9 May 2027, with the theme/program 'announcement coming soon' — so the dates are recorded as confirmed but guests as 'none-yet' (the 2026 lineup — Stanislav Yanevski, Josh Herdman, Jill Bearup, Purin, Ari, Ken Liu — belongs to the already-finished 48th edition and is not carried over). Organizer inferred from the nav link to 'Sfera.hr', the Zagreb SF association that runs the convention; not independently re-confirmed beyond that link. Venue not yet stated for 2027.
